verdict.rationale: HumanLayer is a human-oversight and agent-orchestration product, so an auto-approve or bypass-confirmation setting is a fair axis. The evidence pack never documents a setting that auto-approves all agent actions. The closest items are adjacent: Oneshot is a lighter workflow choice (fewer review phases, not per-action approval), non-interactive `automation run` sessions don't say how action approvals are handled, and launch tokens are authentication for non-interactive commands.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to auto-approve all its actions instead of confirming each one
